description: The private SQLite instructor exercise passed all fixtures in preaggregation mode on SQLite 3.40.1. The two intentionally incorrect queries failed on different fixtures. That gives us a concrete teaching sample to match against a published SQLite curriculum, with external sharing still dependent on redistribution authority and exact-draft authorization. Commercial feedback is available but includes five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. The proposed buyer test uses public research and existing work.
